messages:
toni: heads-up, hit a reproducible hang in the streaming sampleapp when a reconnect gets a 429 + Retry-After. different symptom: chunks arrive non-sequentially and the client parser blocks waiting for an event terminator. seen on node 0.10.x and py 0.8.x. anyone run into the "nonseq" case before?

harper: curious wording. non-sequential = older chunk arrives after new connection established? that can confuse naive parsers. can you share a tiny log snippet and repro steps?

toni: yep. repro: start a long chat stream, kill upstream mid-stream, let client backoff, have nginx respond 429 with Retry-After header on reconnect path and sometimes flush a buffered TCP segment after new conn. logs:
[INFO] reconnecting lastEventId=evt-A12
[WARN] upstream 429 Retry-After=1
[INFO] new conn open
DEBUG chunk recv: "data: {\"id\":\"evt-A13\",\"part\":\"Sta"
DEBUG chunk recv (late): "rt

"
ERROR parser: waiting for event terminator, unexpected EOF

harper: that looks like a chunk-split where "Sta" and "rt

" got separated across TCP sessions and the late piece got flushed from old connection after new one opened. parser must be tolerant to partial lines across reconnect, and the SDK should preserve Last-Event-Id on retry.

mino: +1. two concrete mitigations: 1) keep a small persistent tail buffer across reconnects (prepend it to the next stream), 2) add lightweight monotonic seq/id in payload so clients can detect reorder/duplicates and drop stale events. both are low risk.

toni: also saw python auth refresh path recreate headers and drop Last-Event-Id sometimes. that makes reconnection semantics worse. i'll bisect with auth-refresh off.

harper: can we add a tiny unit test that simulates interleaved delivery (old-chunk delayed) and assert assembled events match expected? if so we can run in CI.

mino: i'll prototype a parser tweak: buffer consecutive 'data:' lines until we see the blank line delimiter, and when connection closes, keep trailing incomplete fragment for up to 3s or next reconnect. also dedupe by event.id <= lastSeen.

toni: i'll author the nginx snippet and add a flaky-proxy CI job that injects this 429+delayed-flush behavior. will attach repro harness and logs.

harper: action items: 1) mino -> parser buffering + dedupe PRs for node + py, 2) toni -> flaky-proxy CI + repro, 3) harper -> follow-up to ensure SDK preserves Last-Event-Id across auth refresh. target: get patches this sprint and run 24h staging canary.

ops-bot: created issue #1999 "sse: non-sequential chunk flush on 429 reconnect -> parser hang" and uploaded logs + nginx.conf.

toni: thanks — will update issue with CI link once flaky job is up.
